front: In Amazon EBS, Recycle Bin or snapshot lock: which one stops a delete before it happens?
extra: While a snapshot is locked, [it can't be deleted by any user](../facts/ebs.md#ebs-snapshot-lock-no-user-can-delete). Recycle Bin restores deleted [EBS volumes, EBS snapshots, and EBS-backed AMIs](../facts/ebs.md#ebs-recycle-bin-recovers-volumes-snapshots-amis).
